glossary.definition: (A) "Brand name" means a name or expression, design, or trademark used in connection with one or several grades of any type of fertilizer.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 905.31 to 905.503 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (B) "Bulk fertilizer" means any type of fertilizer in solid, liquid, or gaseous state, or any combination thereof, in a nonpackaged form.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 905.31 to 905.503 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (C) "Distribute" means to offer for sale, sell, barter, or otherwise supply fertilizer for other than manufacturing purposes.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 905.31 to 905.503 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (D) "Fertilizer" means any substance containing nitrogen, phosphorus, or potassium or any recognized plant nutrient element or compound that is used for its plant nutrient content or for compounding mixed fertilizers. "Fertilizer" does not include lime, limestone, marl, unground bone, water, residual farm products, and animal and vegetable manures unless mixed with fertilizer materials or distributed with a guaranteed analysis.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 905.31 to 905.503 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (E) "Grade" means the percentages of total nitrogen, available phosphorus or available phosphate (P2O5), and soluble potassium or soluble potash (K2O) stated in the same terms, order, and percentage as in guaranteed analysis.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 905.31 to 905.503 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition:
(F) "Guaranteed analysis" means:

(1) The minimum percentages of plant nutrients claimed in the following order and form:

Total Nitrogen (N)

per cent

Available phosphate (P2O5)

per cent

Soluble Potash (K2O)

per cent

(2) Guaranteed analysis includes, in the following order:

(a) For bone and tankage, total phosphorus (P) or phosphate (P2O5);

(b) For basic slag and unacidulated phosphatic materials, available and total phosphorus (P) or phosphate (P2O5) and the degree of fineness;

(c) Additional plant nutrients guaranteed expressed as percentage of elements in the order and form as prescribed by rules adopted by the director of agriculture.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 905.31 to 905.503 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (G) "Label" means any written or printed matter on the package or tag attached to it or on the pertinent delivery and billing invoice.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 905.31 to 905.503 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (H) "Manufacture" means to process, granulate, blend, mix, or alter the composition of fertilizers for distribution.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 905.31 to 905.503 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (I) "Mixed fertilizer" means any combination or mixture of fertilizer designed for use, or claimed to have value, in promoting plant growth, including fertilizer pesticide mixtures.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 905.31 to 905.503 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (J) "Net weight" means the weight of a commodity excluding any packaging in pounds or metric equivalent, as determined by a sealed weighing device or other means prescribed by rules adopted by the director.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 905.31 to 905.503 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (K) "Packaged fertilizer" means any type of fertilizer in closed containers of not over one hundred pounds or metric equivalent.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 905.31 to 905.503 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (L) "Per cent" or "percentage" means the percentage of weight.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 905.31 to 905.503 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (L) "Per cent" or "percentage" means the percentage of weight.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 905.31 to 905.503 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (M) "Person" includes any partnership, association, firm, corporation, company, society, individual or combination of individuals, institution, park, or public agency administered by the state or any subdivision of the state.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 905.31 to 905.503 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (N) "Product name" means a coined or specific designation applied to an individual fertilizer material or mixture of a fixed composition and derivation.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 905.31 to 905.503 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (O) "Sale" means exchange of ownership or transfer of custody.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 905.31 to 905.503 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (P) "Official sample" means the sample of fertilizer taken and designated as official by the director.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 905.31 to 905.503 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (Q) "Specialty fertilizer" means any fertilizer designed, labeled, and distributed for uses other than the production of commercial crops.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 905.31 to 905.503 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (R) "Ton" means a net weight of two thousand pounds.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 905.31 to 905.503 of the Revised Code:
As used in sections 905.31 to 905.503 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (T) "Custom mixed fertilizer" means a fertilizer that is not premixed, but that is blended specifically to meet the nutrient needs of one specific customer.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 905.31 to 905.503 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (U) "Director" or "director of agriculture" means the director of agriculture or the director's designee.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 905.31 to 905.503 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (U) "Director" or "director of agriculture" means the director of agriculture or the director's designee.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 905.31 to 905.503 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (V) "Lot" means an identifiable quantity of fertilizer that may be used as an official sample.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 905.31 to 905.503 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (W) "Unit" means twenty pounds of fertilizer or one per cent of a ton.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 905.31 to 905.503 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (X) "Anhydrous ammonia equipment" means, with regard to the handling or storage of anhydrous ammonia, a container or containers with a maximum capacity of not more than four thousand nine hundred ninety-nine gallons or any appurtenances, pumps, compressors, or interconnecting pipes associated with such a container or containers. "Anhydrous ammonia equipment" does not include equipment for the manufacture of anhydrous ammonia or the storage of anhydrous ammonia either underground or in refrigerated structures.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 905.31 to 905.503 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (Y) "Anhydrous ammonia system" or "system" means, with regard to the handling or storage of anhydrous ammonia, a container or containers with a minimum capacity of not less than five thousand gallons or any appurtenances, pumps, compressors, or interconnecting pipes associated with such a container or containers. "Anhydrous ammonia system" does not include equipment for the manufacture of anhydrous ammonia or the storage of anhydrous ammonia either underground or in refrigerated structures.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 905.31 to 905.503 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (Y) "Anhydrous ammonia system" or "system" means, with regard to the handling or storage of anhydrous ammonia, a container or containers with a minimum capacity of not less than five thousand gallons or any appurtenances, pumps, compressors, or interconnecting pipes associated with such a container or containers. "Anhydrous ammonia system" does not include equipment for the manufacture of anhydrous ammonia or the storage of anhydrous ammonia either underground or in refrigerated structures.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 905.31 to 905.503 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (Z) "Agricultural production" means the cultivation, primarily for sale, of plants or any parts of plants on more than fifty acres. "Agricultural production" does not include the use of start-up fertilizer applied through a planter.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 905.31 to 905.503 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (AA) "Rule" means a rule adopted under section 905.322 , 905.40 , or 905.44 of the Revised Code, as applicable.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 905.31 to 905.503 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (BB) "Certificate holder" means a person who has been certified to apply fertilizer under section 905.321 of the Revised Code and rules adopted under section 905.322 of the Revised Code.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 905.31 to 905.503 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (CC) "Residual farm products" has the same meaning as in section 939.01 of the Revised Code.
